name: Splitter
purpose: Present resizable adjacent panels using Atom sizing and a theme-aware separator and grip.
useWhen: Neighboring content panels share resizable space.

avoidWhen.condition: Only one preview element is resized.
avoidWhen.useInstead: A qualified application adapter rather than fake empty panels

composition: Root declares stable panels; compose Panel and named ResizeTrigger in the same order. Frame establishes outer dimensions; Surface supplies optional panel paint. Empty triggers include a separator and indicator.

rules.statement: Use public Atom-backed sizing; do not replace drag, keyboard, collapse or ARIA in consumer CSS.
Load styles.css or core.css plus splitter.css. Keep panel padding, paint and scrolling on their proper owners.
Name every ResizeTrigger and provide application non-drag controls such as presets/reset. Preserve stable IDs and logical order.

commonMistakes.mistake: Treating the indicator's small visual width as its interaction target.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep the default independent target geometry; decorative children must not contain actions.

validation: Verify orientation, RTL, constraints, hover/focus/drag, disabled, forced colors, nested panels and iframe crossings.
Verify definite vertical size, localized names and controlled sizes; persistence belongs to the app.
